title: Signal: Shell history file served from the web root
scope: One response body containing a shell history with directory changes and operational commands.
limitations: One response body. The rule recognises the history shape; a single line of text is not reported.

observation.body:
cd /var/www/shop
sudo systemctl restart nginx
kubectl get pods -n shop

cd /srv
mysqldump -h db.internal -u app shop > dump.sql
curl -s http://cache.internal:6379/ping
Run the commands in order and restart the service afterwards.
Run the migrations before restarting the service.

fpNotes: A page that shows a command example is reported only when several command lines appear at line starts.
